current_facts.description: WorkerBridge possesses only a single static slot for operator startup configuration (_activeAdmissionReceipt / _activeStartupConfig) sealed via _operatorConfigSealed.
current_facts.observation: Once TryInstallOperatorStartupConfig succeeds, _operatorConfigSealed is set to true and subsequent installation calls return false. No slot exists for a child validator receipt.

current_facts.description: HandleLaunchOperatorValidator derives executable, arguments, and working directory directly from the parent SIMULATION worker config.
current_facts.observation: exePath = _activeStartupConfig.AdmittedValidatorExecutablePath; baseArgs = _activeStartupConfig.ValidatorArguments; workingDir = _activeStartupConfig.ValidatorCwd. No child role or 7 startup arguments are passed.

current_facts.description: OperatorRolePathSelector strictly returns WorkerUserDataDirectory for SIMULATION and ValidatorUserDataDirectory for READ_ONLY.
current_facts.observation: SelectUserData throws InvalidOperationException if role is neither SIMULATION nor READ_ONLY. Source selection defect closed in R25.

current_facts.description: OperatorStartupAdmissionReceipt and OperatorStartupConfigSnapshot enforce deep immutability, raw byte SHA256 preflight checks, and descriptor matching.
current_facts.observation: Receipt Schema version WE-OPERATOR-RECEIPT-V1 and Config Schema version WE-OPERATOR-BOOTSTRAP-V1 are byte-fixed.

current_facts.description: Checked-in Multiplayer HostUtil.cs demonstrates reference usage of -savedatafolder argument.
current_facts.observation: Lines 224-225: if (GenCommandLine.TryGetCommandLineArg("savedatafolder", out string saveDataFolder)) args += $" \"-savedatafolder={saveDataFolder}\""; This is reference usage, not evidence of native runtime support in RimWorld base game.

proposed_mechanisms.name: Private Child Validator Admission Receipt Storage and API
proposed_mechanisms.description: Introduce private static OperatorStartupAdmissionReceipt? _activeChildValidatorReceipt and internal static bool TryRegisterChildValidatorReceipt(OperatorStartupAdmissionReceipt childReceipt).
validation_invariants: childReceipt must be non-null and valid (IsValid() == true)
childReceipt executable path and SHA256 must match parent SIMULATION config exactly
childReceipt content profile fingerprint must match parent SIMULATION config exactly
Single-active registration under _configLock; reject overwrite while active
proposed_mechanisms.pure_seam: Method can be invoked directly in pure unit tests with pre-constructed admission receipts.

proposed_mechanisms.name: Pure ChildValidatorLaunchPlanBuilder DTO & Builder
proposed_mechanisms.description: Construct an immutable ChildValidatorLaunchPlan from parent SIMULATION receipt, registered child READ_ONLY receipt, and active sealed task (27 fields).
proposed_mechanisms.pure_seam: Static pure function returning (bool isValid, string error, ChildValidatorLaunchPlan? plan) without process execution or filesystem side effects.

proposed_mechanisms.name: Strict Parameter Token Vector Construction
proposed_mechanisms.description: Format child launch arguments using the exact 7 mandatory operator keys plus reference -savedatafolder and task parameters.
proposed_mechanisms.pure_seam: Deterministic formatting verified via exact string comparison in prospective unit oracle.

proposed_mechanisms.name: Child Receipt Consumption & Revocation
proposed_mechanisms.description: Child receipt registration is single-use: consumed upon Process.Start or cleared upon task abort/timeout/revocation via RevokeChildValidatorReceipt().

unresolved_prerequisites.description: The external Operator orchestration plane must issue a distinct READ_ONLY configuration JSON file and launch descriptor with unique configId and valid SHA256.
Empirical proof that RimWorld executable (Verse.GenCommandLine / Unity player) accepts and respects -savedatafolder without crashing or reverting to default UserData directory.
Filesystem preparation of ValidatorUserDataDirectory and ValidatorCwd distinct from WorkerUserDataDirectory.
Child process must have read access to the parent's staged save game artifact without modifying or locking parent files.
Allocation of a distinct loopback TCP port for the child validator bridge and establishing mutually authenticated communication.
